login.title: Sign in
login.headline: See the evidence before you see the score.
login.subhead: HireLens binds a CV to a job description. The model cannot advance a stage; every number rests on a quote.
login.point1: A numeric score cannot exist without a source quote.
login.point2: No auto-accept or auto-reject. The rationale stays with the human.
login.point3: Pre-interviews turn speech into text. No face or emotion analysis.
login.subject: User subject
login.hint: This form is local-only. On BTP, sign-in is SAP IAS/XSUAA.

sessionError.title: Could not open your workspace
sessionError.body: Sign-in succeeded, but the workspace could not be loaded. Sign out and try again. If it persists, contact IT.

tour.autoHint: The cursor advances automatically; you can also tap Next.
tour.stepFunnelBody: Open roles → candidates → evaluation → interview → decision. The numbers summarize that pipeline.
tour.stepRecentBody: Jump into Candidates for a role. Criteria weights drive JD matching.
tour.stepOversightBody: AI produces scores and evidence; shortlist/reject stays with the recruiter. No auto-hire.
tour.stepNavBody: Create and edit job postings and criteria here. The demo cursor will take you there.
tour.stepComposerBody: Fill title, job description, and the criteria table. Weights must sum to 100.
tour.stepListBody: Edit updates the JD; Candidates opens CV upload and scoring.
tour.stepCandidatesBody: Add someone to the role, select them, then the CV zone unlocks.
tour.stepUploadBody: Upload triggers parse + JD match. The evaluation screen shows evidence-backed scores.
tour.stepDoneBody: Flow: Dashboard → Position → Candidate + CV → Evaluation → Shortlist / interview. Try it yourself.

decision.title: Your decision
decision.shortlistRationale: HR shortlist: evidence and scores reviewed.
decision.rationaleHint: The decision is yours. A rationale is required; the system does not advance stages alone.
decision.rationalePlaceholder: e.g. Strong technical background, but weak evidence on Support…
decision.overrideHint: You record a reasoned decision, not a new number.

score.glossaryAria: Explain how this list is ranked
score.glossaryScoreBody: Quality of the evidence we found, 0–100. Saying ‘I did it’ is not enough; concrete project, duration, or output raises the score. High coverage with weak quotes still yields a low score.
score.glossaryCoverageBody: How many job items have any CV quote at all — a percentage. It ignores quality: mentioned or not. 30% means 3 of 10 items have text; the other 7 are blank. That does not change the score on those 3 items.
score.glossaryHowBody: Score comes first: 59 ranks above 48. Coverage does not change that — until two people have the same score. On a tie, the CV that covers more of the job ranks first.

{{url}}

interview.historyHint: A new invite does not erase the previous session. Summary, score, and transcript stay here.
